title: Poietic Agents
description: TLDR: Test whether initially identical agents can develop efficient shared data services and cheaper execution without losing fresh, correct answers. First native qualification stopped after 36 relay failures; 144 assigned outcomes are retained and no model or swarm effect is established. Prospective S0-02 retains provider receipts and stops on first interface failure, using fresh cases, original thresholds and the same USD2 cumulative cap. S1/S2 remain closed. Repair is prepared with63 offline checks and awaits owner approval; the first allocation is released.

stage.description: S0 qualification | S1 development | S2 closed pending formal review

arm.description: A0 generalists | A1 cache | A2 static | A3 Poietic; A4-A6 deferred

world.description: Separate overlap or schema changes; later isolated provider-loss tests
